tldr: Venus through the 10th house softens career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When Venus moves through your 10th house, it draws your attention toward career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
